criteria.rationale: The deliverable accurately reflects all order data from the pick tickets and applies the operative approval status from the workspace registry. Specifically, while the attached Shipping parameters file, working-notes.txt, and draft record-22.txt list a $110 flat rate for Freight, registry.txt establishes that revision 2 (record-17.txt, $150 Freight flat rate) is the approved record in force and revision 3 (record-22.txt) is an unapproved draft. The manifest uses the $150 approved rate for Pick Ticket B-5005 (250 lbs, Freight), yielding $75.00 in savings against the $225.00 industry average, and explicitly documents this governance resolution and the unprovided tracking numbers in row 8 without inventing missing data.

record-17.txt: revision 2; approved 2025-06-20; status in force; approved by process owner.
record-22.txt: revision 3; created 2025-06-23; status draft; not approved.
The registry, not recency alone, determines which record is operative.

criteria.counterevidence: Competing evidence exists in attachment:Shipping parameters.xlsx ('flat rate $110'), attachment:working-notes.txt ('Working notes copied on 2025-06-23 from a revision-3 proposal. Freight flat rate per qualifying shipment: USD 110.'), and workspace:record-22.txt ('Freight flat rate per qualifying shipment: USD 110.'). However, workspace:registry.txt explicitly states that record-22.txt (revision 3) is an unapproved draft and record-17.txt (revision 2, USD 150) is approved and in force, which resolves the conflict per the prompt instructions.
